MAR.note: Dashboard states no statistics from administrative records.
Gives only bandwidth per user in kbit/s, no route or cable.

facts.fact: The ITU Digital Development Dashboard gives an ITU estimate that 91% of Morocco's population used the internet in 2022.
The ITU Digital Development Dashboard gives Morocco's mobile broadband basket at 1.0% of GNI per capita in 2022.
The ITU Digital Development Dashboard gives 96% of individuals in Morocco owning a mobile phone in 2021.
